bio.p2: My main stack is React 19, Flask/Python, and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel with CI/CD from GitHub. I've delivered projects for real local businesses —QR digital menus, conversion landing pages— and maintain this portfolio as a live example of what I do.
bio.p3: I'm looking to join a technical team where I can grow as a Full Stack developer, contributing from day one on both frontend and backend. Available for on-site positions in Madrid or remote.

q1.question: How long does a web project take?
q1.answer: It depends on the complexity. A landing page: 1-2 weeks. A full web application: 4-8 weeks. We always set clear deadlines before starting.

q2.question: Do you work with clients outside Spain?
q2.answer: Yes, I work with clients from any country. Communication is mainly via video call and email, in Spanish or English.

q3.question: What does post-launch support include?
q3.answer: 1 month of support included in all projects. Bug fixes, minor adjustments and answers to technical questions.

q4.question: Can I see examples of your work?
q4.answer: Sure, visit the projects section where you'll find detailed case studies with the problem, technical decisions and result of each project.

q5.question: How does payment work?
q5.answer: 50% at the start of the project and 50% on delivery. For larger projects we can agree on milestone-based payments.
